_source: ASL-Phono, Cleison Correia de Amorim and Cleber Zanchettin (2021)
_coordinates: +x signer right, +y up, +z away from body; unit vectors
_gate: Strictly more than 50% of valid frame observations, independently per channel
_warning: Vision estimates at 3 fps, not human annotations or validated ASL. Frame consensus is not cross-signer agreement. Same gloss can hide lexical variants. All source frames are retained, including quantized boundary frames.
